_comment: THE CHECKS busbar declares for the release turnstile beyond the `cargo xtask gate` battery (busbar-release-turnstile `pipeline.rs`: a check runs when the rung being entered is in its `rungs`; `run` is one bash line run in the checkout with pipefail; every `<id>\t<PASS|FAIL|SKIP>\t<title>\t<detail>` line it prints is a ledger row). fuzz-smoke: every coverage-guided harness `fuzz/Cargo.toml` declares as a `[[bin]]` is built with libFuzzer's coverage instrumentation on the pinned stable toolchain (the flags cargo-fuzz passes, so no nightly and no cargo-fuzz install) and run for 60 s from an empty corpus; a harness that does not build or crashes is a FAIL row, and a manifest declaring no harness is a FAIL, never a pass that fuzzed nothing (Law 8). The harnesses are a separate workspace, so this is the only place they build. Run at the qa and main rungs, where the removed qa-fuzz.yml ran.

checks.run:
host=$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p'); targets=$(awk '/^\[\[bin\]\]/{b=1;next} b&&/^name *=/{gsub(/^name *= *"|"$/,"");print;b=0}' fuzz/Cargo.toml); [ -n "$targets" ] || { printf 'fuzz-smoke:targets	FAIL	the fuzz harnesses	fuzz/Cargo.toml declares no [[bin]] target, so this check would fuzz nothing
'; exit 1; }; rc=0; for t in $targets; do if RUSTFLAGS='-Cpasses=sancov-module -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-level=4 -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-inline-8bit-counters -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-pc-table -Cllvm-args=-sanitizer-coverage-trace-compares --cfg fuzzing -Cdebug-assertions -Coverflow-checks' cargo build --release --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --target-dir fuzz/target --target "$host" --bin "$t" >&2 && mkdir -p "fuzz/target/corpus-$t" && "fuzz/target/$host/release/$t" "fuzz/target/corpus-$t" -max_total_time=60 >&2; then printf 'fuzz-smoke:%s	PASS	%s	60 s, no crash
' "$t" "$t"; else printf 'fuzz-smoke:%s	FAIL	%s	the harness did not build, or crashed within 60 s
' "$t" "$t"; rc=1; fi; done; exit $rc
